title: Music Loft
shortDescription: Strings and sunbeams share a little room above the quad.
longDescription:
Music stands gather in a loose circle beneath the sloping roof. A covered harp makes a tent of blue velvet, while a kettle-shaped drum waits with the patient air of someone used to being misunderstood.
A folded page props up the foot of one wobbly stand. On its exposed corner, a tiny painted bird seems to be singing directly at the floor.

fixtures.name: Folded Page
fixtures.examineDescription: You ease the page into view without upsetting the stand. It is the missing lantern-wren entry: a bird whose throat glows softly while it sings. On the back, someone has written, 'Borrowed to copy the tune. Then the stand wobbled. I meant to return it.' You memorise the location and the apology for Quill; the fragile sheet stays safe beneath its clip.
